canonical_name: IBN Breakfast Club – Mills River NC
summary: A monthly free breakfast networking event at Mills River Restaurant, run by Incredible Towns of WNC as part of its Incredible Business Networking (IBN) program. Both event listings and the parent organization's site explicitly state it is open to all with no dues, fees, or membership requirements, matching the five other IBN chapters already evaluated as open drop-in networking rather than a fixed-membership group.

evidence.note: Listing states: 'IBN Breakfast Club – Mills River is open to all. Never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements.'
2024 listing uses identical open-to-all/no-membership language, confirming the format hasn't changed over two years.
Parent organization describes it as a free, open drop-in event on the 1st Wednesday of each month, 8-9 AM, with no formal membership structure and casual business-card networking.

Same organizer and boilerplate as the five sibling IBN chapters already classified not_group (0.65-0.85), reinforcing that this is a franchised open-networking format, not a persistent membership club.
